finding: Three Factory files write T IDs into docs/spec/work/todos.md, not todo.md: playbooks/architecture-review.md appends T-$(date +%s)-001 entries, agents/coaching-agent.md files T-NNN entries, and playbooks/brownfield-onboarding.md documents debt there. BR-107 makes only todo.md writers T producers, and BR-099 does not read todos.md. So these files keep numbering T outside next-id. T-0008 tracks the merge of the two lists. Name todos.md and its writers as out of scope with a reference to T-0008, or add them to the scope.
why_this_severity: The IDs in todos.md use other forms than T-NNNN, so they do not collide with the counter in this project (no to fails_purpose); a planner cannot tell from the specification whether these files are forgotten or left out on purpose (raises_cost).
